Asia ( / ˈ eɪ ʒ ə / ⓘ AY -zhə , UK also / ˈ eɪ ʃ ə / AY -shə ) is the largest continent [ note 1 ] [ 10 ] [ 11 ] in the world by both land area and population. [ 11 ] It covers an area of more than 44 million square kilometres, [ note 2 ] about 30% of Earth's total land area and 8% of Earth's total surface area. The continent, which has long been home to the majority of the human population , [ 12 ] was the site of many of the first civilisations . Its 4.7 billion people constitute roughly 60% of the world's population.
